'''Miller''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Following the [[Battle of Asylum]] she traveled to [[Odessen]] and joined the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] against the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. She was assigned to the military branch of the Alliance under former Republic Admiral [[Bey'wan Aygo]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sergeant Miller appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' as a Trooper vendor in the Alliance base on Odessen.
